_comment: Read-only HTTP API for websites and tools (GET /api/v1 lists endpoints). Saved changes apply within a few seconds; changing enabled or prefixes restarts the listener. On Windows, prefixes other than http://localhost:PORT/ need: netsh http add urlacl url=http://+:8085/ user=Everyone
_api_key_help: Leave empty for no auth. When set, clients send it in the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>).
_cors_help: Origins allowed to call the API from a browser, e.g. ["https://example.com"] or ["*"].
